The institutional investor held 89,894 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $13.86M, down from 95,522 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Train Babcock Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $922.05B market cap company. The stock increased 0.97% or $1.7398   $181.7198.
